meta.scope: Known non-RUJI-Swap app-layer THORChain swap fees from Base Layer collector conversion runs.
meta.method: Find Base Layer revenue collector wasm-rujira-revenue/run heights, match same-block rujira-thorchain-swap memos to THORNode swap events, and sum liquidity_fee_in_rune.
meta.caveat: This is a second analysis path for base-layer fees generated by app-layer contract activity, not explicit revenue-share payments. It is intentionally scoped to Base Layer collector conversion activity and excludes the RUJI Swap revenue collector.
